description: Build the new Go send-only voice sidecar in JainaVoiceSidecar/ using disgoorg/disgo + disgoorg/godave: own gateway connection with the bot TOKEN, a single POST /play HTTP endpoint that joins a voice channel self-deafened, transcodes a WAV to 48kHz stereo Opus and transmits under DAVE, then leaves cleanly, with bounded timeouts and the godave #11 stage-channel guard. Includes the multi-stage Dockerfile bundling ffmpeg + libdave and a README. Independent of FEAT-002/003 (new directory, no .NET deps), but ordered first because the bot (FEAT-002) and docs (FEAT-003) reference its /play contract and env vars.
steps: Create JainaVoiceSidecar/go.mod: module github.com/kristoffer-tvera/jaina-voice-sidecar, go 1.26.0, with PINNED requires copied from disgo/_examples/voice/godave/go.mod: github.com/disgoorg/disgo v0.19.6, github.com/disgoorg/godave/golibdave v0.3.0 (indirect github.com/disgoorg/godave v0.3.0 + github.com/disgoorg/godave/libdave v0.3.0), github.com/disgoorg/snowflake/v2 v2.0.3, plus github.com/kazzmir/opus-go (the Opus encoder used by disgo/_examples/voice/mp3). Do NOT float versions. Run `go mod tidy`.
Create JainaVoiceSidecar/config.go: a config struct {Token, Port, SidecarToken string} and loadConfig() that reads env TOKEN (required, error if empty), PORT (default 8080), SIDECAR_TOKEN (optional).

Create JainaVoiceSidecar/main.go: disgo.New(cfg.Token, bot.WithGatewayConfigOpts(gateway.WithIntents(gateway.IntentGuildVoiceStates)), bot.WithVoiceManagerConfigOpts(voice.WithDaveSessionCreateFunc(golibdave.NewSession))); client.OpenGateway(ctx); start the HTTP server; block on SIGINT/SIGTERM; client.Close(ctx) on shutdown. Use log/slog. Import "C" is pulled in transitively by golibdave (CGO). Send-only: never set an OpusFrameReceiver.

Create JainaVoiceSidecar/opusprovider.go: a type implementing voice.OpusFrameProvider (ProvideOpusFrame() ([]byte, error); Close()). Start ffmpeg `-hide_banner -loglevel panic -i pipe:0 -ac 2 -f s16le -ar 48000 pipe:1`; write the WAV bytes to stdin in a goroutine then close stdin for EOF; read 48kHz/stereo/s16le PCM from stdout in chunks of voice.OpusFrameSize*2*2 bytes; convert little-endian bytes to []int16; encode with opus.NewEncoder(48000, 2, opus.ApplicationVoIP) + encoder.Encode(pcm, voice.OpusFrameSize, buf); return io.EOF at stream end (zero-pad a short final frame exactly like disgo/_examples/voice/mp3/main.go). Close() kills ffmpeg and closes the encoder.

Create JainaVoiceSidecar/play.go: playWav(ctx, guildID, channelID snowflake.ID, wav []byte) error. conn := client.VoiceManager.CreateConn(guildID); conn.Open(openCtx, channelID, false, true) under a bounded timeout (self-deaf, send-only); conn.SetSpeaking(ctx, voice.SpeakingFlagMicrophone); poll conn.DAVE().Ready() on a ticker bounded by a deadline context and, if it never flips (godave #11 stage/v0-passthrough), log and return a clear typed error; on Ready call conn.SetOpusFrameProvider(provider) and wait (bounded max-playback timeout) for the provider to reach EOF; ALWAYS defer conn.Close(leaveCtx) so the channel is left even on failure. CONFIRM conn.DAVE() compiles at the pinned disgo version; if not, bump disgo to the minimum version where disgo/_examples/voice/godave builds, keeping disgo+godave paired as that example's go.mod pairs them, and re-pin (still no floating).

Create JainaVoiceSidecar/server.go and wire into main.go: bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT. POST /play with guildId and channelId as query params (parse with snowflake.Parse) and the WAV as the raw request body (Content-Type audio/wav or application/octet-stream - raw body, no base64). If cfg.SidecarToken != "", require header X-Sidecar-Token to equal it else 401. 400 on bad input; 200 on success; 409 or 422 with the stage/not-ready message for the godave #11 case; 502/504 on transcode/play failure. Add GET /healthz returning 200. Call playWav with a per-request bounded context.

Create JainaVoiceSidecar/README.md: what it is (send-only DAVE voice sidecar), env vars (TOKEN, PORT, SIDECAR_TOKEN), the /play contract (POST, guildId/channelId query params, raw WAV body, X-Sidecar-Token header, status codes), the godave<->libdave version pairing (state the EXACT libdave version read from github.com/disgoorg/godave/libdave/release.txt at godave v0.3.0), how golibdave loads libdave (CGO dynamic link; LD_LIBRARY_PATH / loader path), and build/run the container.

Create JainaVoiceSidecar/Dockerfile (multi-stage) + JainaVoiceSidecar/.dockerignore. Build stage: Go 1.26 image with C toolchain (CGO_ENABLED=1), git/curl/unzip; install libdave for the godave-required version (run godave scripts/libdave_install.sh OR replicate the bot Dockerfile fetch of discord/libdave release asset libdave-Linux-X64-boringssl.zip extracting lib/libdave.so) with headers+lib present at build; `go build` the binary. Runtime stage: small Debian slim (glibc, since the boringssl libdave is glibc unless the MUSL build is used) with ffmpeg + ca-certificates + libdave.so on the loader path (set LD_LIBRARY_PATH or place in /usr/local/lib + ldconfig); keep libdave license texts; copy the binary; EXPOSE 8080; ENTRYPOINT the binary.

IMPORTANT libdave-version check: read github.com/disgoorg/godave/libdave/release.txt at godave v0.3.0 (currently v1.1.0) and use THAT libdave version for the download, NOT the task's v1.2.2, because godave requires its paired libdave ABI. Document the deviation in README. If release.txt says v1.2.2, use v1.2.2. The pairing wins over the task's literal v1.2.2.
acceptance_criteria: `cd JainaVoiceSidecar && go mod tidy` resolves cleanly and writes go.sum; disgo and godave versions are pinned (no floating).
`docker build -t jaina-voice-sidecar JainaVoiceSidecar` succeeds (CGO links libdave; ffmpeg + libdave + ca-certificates in the runtime image).
`docker run --rm jaina-voice-sidecar` with no TOKEN fails fast with the config error; with TOKEN set it binds 0.0.0.0:$PORT and logs it, and GET /healthz returns 200.

The code mirrors the real disgo API (CreateConn/Open(ctx,channelId,false,true)/SetSpeaking/SetOpusFrameProvider/Close, voice.OpusFrameProvider, kazzmir/opus-go encoder) and never subscribes to inbound audio.
playWav always leaves the channel (defer Close) and bounds join/Ready/play with timeouts; the godave #11 stage/not-ready case returns a clear error instead of hanging.
The README documents TOKEN/PORT/SIDECAR_TOKEN, the /play contract, and the godave<->libdave version pairing with the exact libdave version used.
verification: docker run --rm jaina-voice-sidecar  (expect fast config-error without TOKEN)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED JainaVoiceSidecar/ (Go module github.com/kristoffer-tvera/jaina-voice-sidecar): go.mod, go.sum, config.go, main.go, opusprovider.go, play.go, server.go, README.md, Dockerfile, .dockerignore.

== FINAL VERSION PAIRING (both open risks resolved) ==
- disgo: v0.19.7-0.20261101233420-18ac6df9b116 (master pseudo-version, commit 18ac6df9b116, 2026-11-01).
- godave/golibdave: v0.3.0 (+ indirect godave v0.3.0, godave/libdave v0.3.0).
- snowflake/v2: v2.0.3.
- kazzmir/opus-go: v1.7.0 (pure Go, no extra cgo).
- native libdave.so: v1.1.0 (release tag path is 'v1.1.0/cpp', asset libdave-Linux-X64-boringssl.zip).
- transitive klauspost/compress resolved to v1.19.0 by `go mod tidy` (not a floated direct pin).

== RISK (a) libdave version — RESOLVED ==
Read github.com/disgoorg/godave/libdave/release.txt at godave v0.3.0 -> it pins libdave v1.1.0 (NOT the task's literal v1.2.2). Used v1.1.0 because godave requires its paired libdave ABI; the task's v1.2.2 was the old .NET/Discord.Net consumer and does not bind the sidecar. Deviation documented in JainaVoiceSidecar/README.md 'Version pairing'. Dockerfile downloads https://github.com/discord/libdave/releases/download/v1.1.0/cpp/libdave-Linux-X64-boringssl.zip (note the '/cpp' in the tag path).

== RISK (b) conn.DAVE().Ready() compile — RESOLVED (required a disgo re-pin) ==
conn.DAVE() does NOT exist on the voice.Conn interface at the v0.19.6 TAG (confirmed by reading voice/conn.go@v0.19.6: methods are Gateway/UDP/ChannelID/.../Open/Close, no DAVE()). It was added to the Conn interface ONLY on master (voice/conn.go@master has `DAVE() godave.Session`), where the godave example that calls conn.DAVE().Ready() lives. The example's own go.mod still names disgo v0.19.6 but is stale: it would not compile against the tag. No tagged disgo release contains DAVE(). Per the FEAT's instruction, bumped disgo to the minimum published version where the godave example builds = the master pseudo-version containing DAVE(); godave kept at the example's v0.3.0 pairing. Nothing floats.

== API FACTS verified against pinned sources (not invented) ==
disgo.New returns (*bot.Client, error); client.VoiceManager.CreateConn(guildID) -> voice.Conn; conn.Open(ctx, channelID, selfMute=false, selfDeaf=true) for send-only self-deaf; conn.SetSpeaking(ctx, voice.SpeakingFlagMicrophone); conn.DAVE().Ready() (godave session Ready()); conn.SetOpusFrameProvider(voice.OpusFrameProvider{ProvideOpusFrame()([]byte,error); Close()}); conn.Close(ctx). voice.OpusFrameSize=960, frame PCM = OpusFrameSize*2*2 bytes. opus.NewEncoder(48000,2,opus.ApplicationVoIP); encoder.Encode(pcm []int16, voice.OpusFrameSize, buf). golibdave.NewSession is a godave.SessionCreateFunc used directly in bot.WithVoiceManagerConfigOpts(voice.WithDaveSessionCreateFunc(golibdave.NewSession)). snowflake.Parse(str)->(ID,error). The disgo AudioSender itself gates sending on conn.DAVE().Ready(), confirming the godave #11 guard: if Ready() never flips, nothing is sent — play.go bounds the Ready() wait (15s) and returns errDaveNotReady -> HTTP 422.

== /play CONTRACT (for FEAT-002/003) ==
POST /play?guildId=<snowflake>&channelId=<snowflake>, raw WAV request body (Content-Type audio/wav or application/octet-stream, no base64). Optional header X-Sidecar-Token (required only when SIDECAR_TOKEN env is set). Status: 200 ok; 400 bad/missing ids or empty body; 401 bad/missing token; 413 body too large (cap 25 MiB); 422 DAVE-not-ready (stage/v0 passthrough, godave #11); 502 join/transcode/play failure; 504 playback timeout. GET /healthz -> 200. Env vars: TOKEN (required), PORT (default 8080), SIDECAR_TOKEN (optional). Default bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT. Bot->sidecar over Docker container name (no external port published). Timeouts: open 20s, DAVE ready 15s, max playback 2m, leave 10s, per-request 3m. playWav always defers conn.Close so the channel is left even on failure. Send-only: never sets an OpusFrameReceiver.

== VERIFICATION RUN (this commit) ==
Local toolchain was absent (no go/docker/gh on PATH). Installed Go 1.27.3 (winget GoLang.Go) and MinGW gcc (winget BrechtSanders.WinLibs) to run the named checks.
- `go mod tidy` (in JainaVoiceSidecar): SUCCESS; resolved all pins and wrote go.sum. `go mod verify`: all modules verified.
- `go vet ./...` (CGO disabled; canonical fast check): CLEAN, exit 0. Note main.go is a cgo file (import "C"), so it is excluded when CGO_ENABLED=0.
- `go vet .` with CGO_ENABLED=1 + gcc + libdave headers (stub pkg-config): CLEAN after fixing a real bug — the Go doc comment was directly above `import "C"` and cgo compiled it as the C preamble; moved it so the package clause sits directly above `import "C"`. This confirms main.go type-checks.
- `go build` with CGO_ENABLED=1 + libdave: reached the final link stage; the ONLY remaining errors were undefined references to libdave symbols (daveDecryptorCreate, daveCommitResult*, ...) using the Windows prebuilt .lib under mingw — i.e. the native libdave linkage, not the Go code. This is exactly the CGO+libdave boundary the task flagged: the authoritative link is the Linux container.
- `docker build -t jaina-voice-sidecar JainaVoiceSidecar` and `docker run --rm jaina-voice-sidecar`: NOT RUN — Docker is not installed on this host and could not be installed here. These remain the authoritative CGO+libdave build/link + runtime config-fail smoke check; the Dockerfile is written to perform `go mod tidy` + CGO build with libdave v1.1.0 present (build stage) and ship ffmpeg + ca-certificates + libdave.so on the loader path (Debian bookworm-slim runtime, matching the glibc boringssl build). Without TOKEN the binary fails fast in loadConfig (os.Exit(1)); with TOKEN it binds 0.0.0.0:$PORT and GET /healthz returns 200.

NOTE: go.sum IS committed (generated by the local `go mod tidy`). Dockerfile also runs `go mod tidy` so the container build is self-contained even if go.sum drifts.
